speaker: Narendra Modi
venue: Address to the Nation (televised), New Delhi
quote_original: आज मैं आपको, पूरे देश को, ये बताने आया हूं कि हमने तीनों कृषि कानूनों को वापस लेने का निर्णय लिया है। इस महीने के अंत में शुरू होने जा रहे संसद सत्र में, हम इन तीनों कृषि कानूनों को Repeal करने की संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया को पूरा कर देंगे।
quote_english: Today I have come to tell you, the whole country, that we have decided to repeal all three agricultural laws. We will complete the constitutional process to repeal these three agricultural laws in the Parliament session that begins later this month.
summary: Parliament passed the Farm Laws Repeal Bill, 2021 on 29 November 2021 and the President gave assent on 30 November 2021, repealing the three 2020 farm laws within the session the Prime Minister had named.

analysis:
PM Narendra Modi announced the repeal of the three farm laws in a televised address on 19 November 2021, two months after the government had already suspended the laws.

Parliament passed the Farm Laws Repeal Bill, 2021 on 29 November 2021 and the President gave assent on 30 November 2021, completing the process in the session the Prime Minister named in the speech.

The claim was a statement of intent with a specific legislative timeline; that timeline was met.
